protocol.calibration: Sigmoid, 3-fold out-of-fold calibration inside each outer training partition; ensemble=False
protocol.selection: Inner ROC-AUC - 0.25 × Brier; select parameters per family, then family. No outer labels used.
protocol.ci: 95% patient-stratified bootstrap (1,000 resamples) of repeat-averaged OOF probabilities; conditional on fitted folds, not external validation
protocol.pooled: Each patient occurs once after averaging their held-out predictions across repeats. Fold SD is descriptive; folds overlap.
protocol.isotonic: Sensitivity comparison only; not selected on outer test data. Sigmoid predeclared for the small cohort.
protocol.shap: Permutation SHAP of exact calibrated probability, 16 training-background patients, 6 held-out patients per outer fold; approximate correlated-feature attributions.
limitations: Single 303-patient referral cohort; no external validation
Independent targets may be inconsistent; CAD is not forced to vessel union
Bootstrap intervals omit retraining and selection uncertainty
Vessel predictions may be substantially weaker than overall CAD

protocol.selection: Four existing demo rows fixed before measuring explanation stability; not representative sampling.
protocol.calibration: Six quantile bins of repeat-averaged held-out predictions. Vertical bars are descriptive 95% Wilson intervals for the observed fraction, conditional on bins; correlated CV fits and model-selection uncertainty are not covered.
protocol.bootstrap: 2000 patient resamples of fixed held-out predictions; conditional on the fitted models, not external validation.
protocol.stability: Seed and computation changes compare with the displayed two-cycle explanation. Background changes compare two eight-cycle explanations with the same seed, changing only training background. Top-five overlap and sign agreement are descriptive, not clinical validity or model uncertainty.
